description:
Create an Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram in Wondershare EdrawMax modeling a subset of the Chinook database schema. 

1. Open EdrawMax and create a new diagram (you may use an ER Diagram template or a blank drawing).
2. Read the schema specification provided in the file `~/Diagrams/chinook_schema_spec.txt`. It contains 5 entities: Artist, Album, Track, Genre, and Invoice.
3. Create these 5 entities in the diagram. Each entity must show its Name and Attributes as listed in the spec file. Mark Primary Keys (PK) and Foreign Keys (FK).
4. Draw relationships between them as specified (e.g., Artist 1:N Album) using appropriate connectors.
5. Save the editable diagram to `/home/ga/Diagrams/chinook_er_diagram.eddx`.
6. Export the diagram as an image to `/home/ga/Diagrams/chinook_er_diagram.png`.

Note: If any startup dialogs appear, close them.
